problem:
Consider the matrix $T$ and the vector $v$ given below. If $T$ is the standard matrix of the linear transformation $T:{R}^{3}\to {R}^{2},$ find $T(v).$

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}3 & -1 & 2 \\ 1 & 4 & -2\end{aligned}],\,v=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution:
Using the fact that $\,T(v)=T\cdot v,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}T(v) & =T\cdot v \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 & -1 & 2 \\ 1 & 4 & -2\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 8\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
